projectDescription: A lightweight, cross-platform desktop code editor built with Tauri (Rust and React) featuring AI agents, Git integration, LSP support, Vim keybindings, and an integrated terminal.
keyFeatures: AI chat and autocomplete with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, xAI Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Ollama
CLI agent integration via Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode
Full Git integration with diff viewer, staging, commit history, worktrees, and inline blame
LSP support for code intelligence including hover, go-to-definition, diagnostics, and inlay hints
Integrated terminal with customizable shell profiles
Vim keybindings with relative line numbers and configurable mode
Syntax highlighting via Tree-sitter WebAssembly grammars
Extension system with support for LSP servers, formatters, linters, themes, and snippets
GitHub integration for pull requests, issues, and Actions
Keybinding presets for VS Code, JetBrains, Sublime Text, Xcode, Atom, Emacs, and Zed
Enterprise managed mode with extension allowlist
publicApiSurface: ExtensionManifest — extension package definition with LSP, grammar, formatter, linter, and UI contributions
LspConfiguration — LSP server configuration with platform-specific executables
AI_PROVIDERS — built-in AI provider registry (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, etc.)
AI_AGENTS — CLI agent registry via ACP protocol
KeybindingPreset — keybinding preset definitions (vscode, jetbrains, sublime, xcode, atom, emacs, zed)
UIContributions — sidebar views, toolbar actions, and menu contributions for extensions
